From the menu

The platters come from the menu board at the entrance. Each one is for two people and comes with salad, starters, chips and dessert. Prices at the restaurant.

Fish platters for two

  • Platter 1: fresh calamari, shrimps and cod
  • Platter 2: fresh calamari, calamari rings and fish of the day
  • Platter 3: fresh calamari, garlic shrimps and fish of the day

Grilled platters for two

  • Platter 4: grilled sea bream, octopus, shrimps and calamari, with rice
  • Platter 5: grilled salmon, fried fish of the day, grilled cuttlefish and shrimps
  • Platter 6: mussels, octopus cooked in wine, cuttlefish, fish of the day, sea bream and shrimps

Meat platter for two

  • Chicken and pork souvlaki, lamb chops
  • Sheftalia, pork fillet and lountza
  • Grilled halloumi, sausages and mushrooms

With every platter

  • Salad
  • Cyprus tahini, tzatziki and fish roe
  • Olives
  • Chips
  • Dessert

At Namare

Photos from the restaurant’s Google listing.

A seafood bar on the seafront

Namare Sea food bar is at 2 Sakkaria Street in Larnaca, facing the sea, with tables inside and outside. The menu board at the entrance lists six fish platters and one meat platter for two, each with salad, tahini, tzatziki, fish roe, olives, chips and dessert. In the reviews guests mention the sea view, grilled octopus and fish soup, and several write about watermelon or a dessert on the house.

Today Namare has no website of its own: the website field in the Google listing leads to the Facebook page. Checked on 22 September 2026.

What guests say

From the Google listing, 4.5 stars on average across 843 reviews.

“Although it's right on the touristic district of old Larnaca, this predominantly fish restaurant surprised us with fresh and nicely cooked barbouni, squid and mussels. They also treated us with delicious watermelon and desert. The prices are reasonable for this area and the service was fast, friendly and polite.”

Google review
“Very generous portions of well prepared food and polite and caring staff.Fish stew was rich with chunks of fish,grilled octopus was perfectly prepared,really tender and delicious.Got cake and coffee by compliments of the house as well.Must visit.”

Google review
“The place is located on the waterfront facing the Mediterranean sea, very convenient with tables both inside and outside to choose from. The staff is very polite, assistive and knows their job very well. The food is fresh, delicious and worth every euro paid. Extremely satisfied.”

Google review
“Great view of the ocean while you eat delicious seafood! We had the meat and seafood mezze and there was so much of it, we couldn't finish! They did give us a takeaway box though. Lots of different dishes, all different - various whole small fried fish including red mullet, a plate of whitebait and another of calamari and octopus, pork belly kebab, chicken kebab, pork chop, and more besides. That doesn't include the huge salad, feta, halloumi, tahini, hummus and all the other things I've forgotten! They even gave us a complementary sweet. Definitely recommended.”
